subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

By whom was Hindi taught to you?

options.text: By whom were you taught Hindi?
Who were you taught Hindi by?

solution:
The **correct answer** is: *Who taught you Hindi?*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Given sentence: ***By whom was Hindi taught to you?***
 
• After analyzing the sentence it is observed that it is an interrogative sentence.
 
• So the rule is to make the passive voice into an active agent.
 
• **‘Wh’ word + auxiliary verb + subject + verb + object? (Active Voice).**
 
• Here the **object** is **Hindi**, the **subject** is **Who,** and the** verb** is **taught(past form of teaching).**

**Hence ****the active voice**** **will be: ***Who taught you Hindi**?* So ***option (3) ***is correct. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional information__ **See some examples to clarify this

 
• Who wrote this letter? (Active Voice)

 By whom was this letter written? (Passive Voice)

 
• Who will call him? (Active Voice)

 By whom will he be called? (Passive Voice).
